scope: Focused independent source review of the two nonexistent-field corrections and the publication error conversion. This is not a review of the entire compiler, all histories, or the forthcoming evaluator change.
observations: FnLoc derives Copy and AcceptedBody::local() is available at the required visibility.
Stored and current IR origins use the same helper. Only a real FnLoc::Item with ItemKind::Fn supplies the full enclosing source interval.
Absent non-item origins cannot admit IR reuse. Existing metadata completion still classifies unsupported declarations.
File, syntax context and interval length checks remain. Statement and terminator spans retain containment and checked translation, followed by the original native IR fingerprint comparison.
The span correction operates only in existing library state. It adds no parser, checker, compiler-selection probe, alternative emitter or complementary ownership.
The publication error converts into a contextual String without swallowing the I/O error. Existing terminal failure, durability-unknown and last-successful publication behavior remain.
verdict: No blocker found in the inspected source changes.
qualification_status: Uncompiled correction pending exact-source hosted construction and campaigns.
